issues.claim: Jack's Hardware & Plumbing, 128 Raritan Ave, operating hardware store
issues.problem: Local history of 128 Raritan Ave says Jack's Hardware closed; the storefront later held Chapter One Books and is now a restaurant. The entry's only source is a generic directory page (localsolution, which 403s to direct access). Defunct business.
issues.fix: Delete the entry; if a hardware store is wanted, verify a current one (none surfaced).

issues.claim: Highland Park Bowling, hpbowling.com, a Highland Park NJ bowling center with event space
issues.problem: hpbowling.com is Highland Park Bowl in Moline, Illinois (48 lanes, Fargo Lounge, Quad Cities). Wrong business; no bowling alley surfaced inside Highland Park NJ in my searches (nearest: North Brunswick). The mapper even recorded the address as 'Unknown'.
issues.fix: Delete. Replace with a real Highland Park NJ event venue if one is needed.

issues.claim: Highland Park Plumbing & Heating, 431 S 7th Ave, website plumbinghighlandpark.com
issues.problem: plumbinghighlandpark.com is a Texas plumbing lead site ('Plumbing Highland Park TX'), not the NJ contractor. The firm itself is real at 431 S 7th Ave per Birdeye/YP listings, so it is the website that is wrong.
issues.fix: Blank the website field or replace it with a verified one; keep address and phone (732-777-1141).

issues.claim: White Lotus Home, 431 Raritan Ave, current mattress/bedding retail store
issues.problem: The company's own blog and locations pages call 431 Raritan Ave its former Highland Park showroom; the current NJ showroom is 745 Joyce Kilmer Ave, New Brunswick. Stale entry that would waste an outreach attempt.
issues.fix: Remove the Highland Park entry (or note 'New Brunswick' and do not treat as in-zone).

issues.claim: Highland Bark, 414 Raritan Ave, pet grooming salon
issues.problem: Listing data (bizarchive, the entry's own source) marks the grooming salon closed. The mapper's note already said 'may have closed - confirm' but the entry was kept with an 'active' phone.
issues.fix: Delete, or downgrade to 'closed' and add Park Pet Palace (1018 Raritan) as the live grooming contact.

issues.claim: Franchise entries: Arthur Murray Highland Park, Kumon of Highland Park, Minuteman Press of Highland Park
issues.problem: All three are franchise-branded operations, and franchises are an excluded type. The mapper flagged Minuteman as 'borderline against the chain rule' and Arthur Murray as 'franchise brand' but included both anyway, and did not treat Kumon consistently.
issues.fix: Apply the franchise rule uniformly - drop all three, or record an explicit written exemption for independently owned franchisees before any of them stay in the list.

issues.claim: The Art of Releve Dance Company, source URL https://www.theartofreleve.org/
issues.problem: Cited URL returns HTTP 404 (root and /classes-1 both fail); only search snippets confirm 233 Raritan Ave. A dead citation is not usable active-evidence.
issues.fix: Re-cite with a page that actually loads, or drop the entry.

issues.claim: Duplicate storefronts left as separate entries
issues.problem: Five address pairs are the same physical business under two names: Kam Soon Auto / ArchAuto (117 Woodbridge), Jaqui-Kuhn / All Faiths Cremation (17 S Adelaide), Durable Parts / Liquid Gold Enterprise (1170 Raritan), Highland Flower / Wonderland Flora (75 Raritan), Spin and Grin / Wayne Wash World III (435 Raritan). Inflates the list and would cause double outreach.
issues.fix: Merge each pair into one entry with the current trading name.

issues.claim: New York Auto Depot Inc., 175-205 Woodbridge Ave
issues.problem: Dealer's own site shows a Union NJ address, so the Highland Park lot may no longer be operating there; listings disagree (175 vs 205). Not counted as a confirmed error, but unverified.
issues.fix: Confirm the Woodbridge Ave lot is still trading before outreach.

issues.claim: Coverage: eligible businesses missing from the list
issues.problem: Park Pet Palace (1018 Raritan Ave, pet grooming/boarding) and Creative Printing USA Inc (320 Raritan Ave, printing) are in categories the list already covers and were not included. The njtgo page the mapper cites as a source also carries eligible listings (e.g. Careza Pharmacy, Unite Pharmacy, Highland Park Tattoo, Studio @ 808, Kinetics Personal Training, Highland Park Wine & Liquors) that were not carried over.
issues.fix: Add verified missing entries; state explicitly which groups (A/B) own pharmacies, salons, personal care and fitness so the gap is intentional.

issues.claim: Website field left blank for businesses that have their own sites
issues.problem: Cyber Knight Computers (cyberknightcomputers.com), Raspa Jewelers (raspajewelers.com), Arch Auto Service (archautoservice.com) and University Laundromat (ulaundromat.com) all have their own sites that surfaced in search but are blank in the list.
issues.fix: Fill the website field for these four and recheck the other 'one directory only' rows for an existing site.

issues.claim: Borderline categories kept without a stated rule
issues.problem: Birnn Chocolates (wholesale confectionery = food production), Pino's Gift Basket Shoppe (gift baskets, part of a wine/gift business), and the childcare/preschool rows (child care centres and two KCE Champions school-site programs appear in the same source) conflict with the 'food' and 'schools' exclusions unless the mapper's group rules say otherwise.
issues.fix: Record the reasoning for each borderline inclusion in the entry notes, or drop the ones the rules bar.
